model: ROLEX Cosmograph Daytona 126519LN (40 mm white gold, METEORITE dial (grey Widmanstaetten pattern) with black sub-dials, black Cerachrom tachymetre bezel, three sub-dials, two white gold screw-down pushers, black Oysterflex rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (hub screw). Follower of the Daytona 126518LN (same Oysterflex strap) and the 126500LN template: same step / prep / kit preset read-only, own measure / spec / job. White gold case, crown and pushers come through the projected photo (no separate gold material); black ceramic bezel (bezel_emission); grey meteorite dial with bright black sub-dials; black Oysterflex strap as three flat rubber columns (flared outer sides lower, raised centre blade higher and a little longer). Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.4625 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = contour of the photo silhouette between the lug rows (horn top y 910 = 22.93 mm, horn bottom y 1990 = 25.15 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: bright chamfer bezel_in 16.10 .. insert_in 17.06 mm, ceramic ring to the ellipse ceramic_out (rx 19.67 mm, ry 19.38 mm, centre 0.37 mm lower than the flange), polished edge ring to the case flank ellipse (rx 20.0 mm); scale, numerals and reflections are the projected photo

hands.note: hands = picked photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons: hour and minute sword hands (black facet and lume strip are photo), chronograph seconds needle with arrow head and paddle tail, the three sub-dial needles with their hub discs; emission = dial emission so the polygons blend into the printed dial

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (the guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1405..1472 px, cap to 1496.5 px, axis 0.49 mm below the pivot, 16 coarse flutes

pushers.note: two screw-down pushers on radial axes through trace.pushers.origin_mm at +-28 deg: neck, fluted ring, narrower cylindrical cap (grooves are texture)

strap.note: Oysterflex rubber strap: columns outer / centre / outer (the photo shows a raised centre blade x 858..1060 px, 20 px longer than the flared sides); the single-column layout was not used because the centre blade ends beyond the sides.

bracelet.note: Oysterflex strap, one rubber piece per column and side. Rows (px, 22.4625 px/mm, pivot (960, 1425)): outer sides end at row 685.0 (top) and 2514.0 (bottom, quantised to the 0.25 mm silhouette rows: 2 px short), centre blade ends at 670.4 (top) and 2528.4 (bottom); column lines x 857.3..858.1 / 1060.0..1060.7 (top rows 700..860), 856.3..858.1 / 1059.3..1061.5 (bottom rows 2060..2510): gradient maxima on 20-100 row bands. Outer edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
